text:
olivia: Heads-up — we're entering code freeze at 3pm PT (≈ 3h). Quick check: any late merges that need release-captain review? If you're requesting an exception, drop details here: impact, rollback plan, changelog entry. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: Docs-only bump (small wording on Config section). Can someone cherry-pick to release branch? PR: #5532. No code changes.

anya: If it's docs-only, ok. @release-captain please approve cherry-pick and assign reviewer. Also add one-line changelog.

release-captain: Quick checklist — doc-only = allowed, but must: 1) add changelog entry, 2) link to CI green on release branch, 3) mention owner for rollback. I'll queue it once PR has `cherry-pick/release-1.6` label.

mike: added label and changelog line. CI green on main; will run backport job now.

devx: pinging @james for a quick thumb if you can take the merge. Otherwise I'll do it.

james: I can take the cherry-pick in 15m. @mike please post the exact `git` snippet you used.

mike: snippet:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b backport/docs-5532 origin/release-1.6
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
git push origin backport/docs-5532
```
Will add PR to release branch once cherry-picked.

sre-bot: Alert — release branch build queued for backport PR. Expect ~12m until status.

olivia: Also reminder: any runtime or model runtime bumps are disallowed in freeze unless emergency. If you think it's an emergency, state severity and rollback.

mike: confirmed docs only.

anya: small question — if a canary is already rolling with changes from main, do we block it? @release-captain

release-captain: Canary allowed if it's not changing APIs and has a rollback. If it's user-visible or model change -> blocked.

devx: for visibility, tagging exception process: https://redwood.inference/internal/release-exception-process

james: backport PR is up, CI green on release branch. @release-captain you can merge.

release-captain: Merged. :white_check_mark: Added changelog entry to release notes. All good.

olivia: thanks everyone. Closing thread — if any follow-ups after freeze, open a new thread with 'post-freeze' tag.
